lens: Skeptic, geometry first. Same q15 camera as w30-w39. Same boxes on r39 / r40 / y_47300 (930x575, LANCZOS): pans y 545-570 (D 180-280, E 330-440, F 490-600, G 660-770), backs y 330-400 at the same x, pillow E (345-430, 430-465), covers E/F y 250-290, far band y 165-225 x 340-610, plus the seat-pixel-only far measure (B > 1.3 R and L < 170) at y 175-225. Belt box y 480-560 per pan (light px L > 150 and B < 1.3 R). q17 cover (670-700, 230-260) vs y_47303; q16 mid rows (300-700, 200-350) vs y_47301. Pixel diff r39 vs r40 (max channel > 8) per 50-row band and per studio unit. My script reproduces every w39a r39 number for pans, back D/E/F, pillow, far and q17 exactly. Script and crops in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/799b632d-abc8-5982-a611-3a2c97f75011/scratchpad/raterA40 (m.py, q15.png = r40 | y_47300, e11.png and e7.png = s39 | s40).
calibrationNote: Backs D and F are tick (yFabric) and backs E and G are fleck (yFabricD), as in w39a. Two box notes. (1) With the stated box, back G on r39 measures L58, not the L50 w39a wrote, so the w39 'G overshoot' was really only on E. (2) The stated cover box y 250-290 gives E/F L71/61 vs photo 65/44 on both r39 and r40, not the L56/57 vs 46/37 w39a wrote; the r39 and r40 values are identical, so the status call does not depend on this. From here on I use these reproducible numbers. The score held at 8.3: the fleck gained 0.2 and the far rows moved back to r38 levels (no score change).

priorIssues.note: Far rows, seat pixels y 175-225: r40 L90 p10 54 L<50 0.035 p90/p10 2.50 vs r39 88 / 54 / 0.042 / 2.51 vs y_47300 84 / 48 / 0.132 / 2.85. The lighter fleck backs undid the small w39 gain, back to the r38 level. There is no dark strip under the far head box, econFarMat is still x0.92, and the 9.5 m LOD near distance is unchanged.

q17 cover #2d396c L60 B/R 2.40, byte-identical to r39, vs y_47303 #8699c5 L153 B/R 1.47. The LIGHT_TUNE.sheen 1.15 -> 1.35 change (0804d1c) has no measurable effect on this box (q17 diff 2.7 %, all at y 100-350 on fleck backs). q15 covers E/F L71/61 vs 65/44 are unchanged.

yFabricD #3e4662 -> #424b68: fleck back E L49 -> 55 (photo 61), B/R 2.14 -> 2.12 (2.24), p90/p10 2.87 -> 2.70 (2.98). Back G L58 -> 63 (64), B/R 1.88 (1.89). G is now matched and E is 6 L dark, half of the w39 gap. Tick back F is still L90 vs 70 and D L91 vs 98 (by design; see w40a-3).
Belt light px D-G (y 480-560): r40 162/20/25/39 = r39 vs photo 96/40/0/15. The strap stubs beside the buckle are unchanged, and the E tongue still shows half the photo's light area.
Pillow E L48 B/R 2.07 p90/p10 1.32, the same as r39, vs L46 / 2.01 / 1.92. e4b diff 3.8 % is the fleck tone behind it; the shape is still a piped plaque.
e7 diff 5.8 % is fabric tone only; the aisle-end lower member is still the separate grey lozenge.
e10 diff 1.2 %, e11 10.8 % (the fleck pan tone; the pouch pixels are unchanged). The pouch is still an opaque even grey fan, and the tag is not visible.
Cameras unchanged. The sheen gain change does not reach the q17 cover (w39a-2).

issues.owner: econ (+ integration for the LOD distance)
issues.title: Far / mid rows too light with no dark row gaps (carried w39a-1, 8 rounds)
issues.evidence: q15 seat pixels y 175-225: r40 L90 p10 54 L<50 0.035 vs y_47300 L84 p10 48 L<50 0.132. The w39 gain (0.042) was lost when the fleck was lightened. The report says a nearer LOD switch turned the rows into flat blocks, so try the econ-side strip first.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econUnitFar: add a dark gap below the head box, B.add(gRBox(0.40, 0.06, 0.02, 0.008, 1), M4.mul(BH, M4.trs(0, 0.60, 0.075)), { c: '#1a1f33', r: 0.95 }), and set the econFarMat factor 0.92 -> 0.86. Keep the 9.5 m LOD. Check: q15 seat-pixel L <= 86 and L<50 >= 0.08, with near-row boxes (y > 330) unchanged.

issues.title: Headrest covers stay navy off-axis; the sheen 1.35 bump did not reach them (carried w39a-2)
issues.evidence: q17 (670-700, 230-260) #2d396c L60 B/R 2.40 in r38, r39 and r40, vs #8699c5 L153 B/R 1.47. LIGHT_TUNE.sheen 1.15 -> 1.35 left the box byte-identical, which suggests yCover is not a SHEEN material, or the lobe is gated off at this N.V.
issues.fix: Lighting: check that SEATMAT.yCover carries the SHEEN flag in mainFS. If not, add it (09_seats.js one line). Econ: yCover c -> '#24283a' (B/R ~1.6), r 0.52 -> 0.40. Check: q17 cover L >= 110 with B/R <= 1.8, and q15 cover F L <= 58.
